import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_path = "./input/train.csv"
test_path = "./input/test.csv"
sample_sub_path = "./input/sample_submission.csv"

train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(sample_sub_path)

# Identify the target column (species)
target_col = [col for col in train_df.columns if "species" in col.lower()][0]

# Get feature names (all columns except id and species)
X_train_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", target_col]]
y_train = train_df[target_col]

# Identify test id column
test_id_col = "id"

# Prepare features for training
X_train = train_df[X_train_cols].values
X_test = test_df[X_train_cols].values

# Hold-out validation split
val_ratio = 0.2
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=val_ratio, stratify=y_train, random_state=42
)

# Map species to integers
classes = sorted(y_train.unique())
class_to_idx = {cls: idx for idx, cls in enumerate(classes)}
y_tr = y_tr.map(class_to_idx)
y_val = y_val.map(class_to_idx)

# Train on training split with improved parameters
model = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=300, max_depth=None, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1, verbose=0
)
model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

# Predict on validation
y_val_pred = model.predict_proba(X_val)


# Calculate Multi-class Log-Loss on Validation Set
def logloss(y_true, y_pred):
    eps = 1e-15
    # Clip predictions
    p = np.clip(y_pred, eps, 1.0 - eps)
    # y_true is one-hot encoded indices
    # Expand y_true to one-hot for calculation
    y_one_hot = np.zeros_like(p)
    y_one_hot[np.arange(len(y_true)), y_true] = 1
    return -np.mean(np.sum(y_one_hot * np.log(p), axis=1))


validation_score = logloss(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation LogLoss: {validation_score}")

# Refit on ALL training data for submission
full_model = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=300, max_depth=None, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1, verbose=0
)
full_model.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Prepare submission - Get species names from sample submission order (skip 'id')
species_order = sample_sub.columns[1:].tolist()
submission_ids = test_df["id"].values

# Predict probabilities - need to reshape to match species order
# Ensure the model's classes are in the same order as sample_submission species order
full_pred_proba = full_model.predict_proba(X_test)

# Verify number of classes matches
n_classes = len(classes)
n_species = len(species_order)
print(f"Number of classes from model: {n_classes}")
print(f"Number of species in sample submission: {n_species}")

# Build mapping from species name to class index
species_to_class_idx = {}
for idx, species_name in enumerate(species_order):
    if species_name in class_to_idx:
        species_to_class_idx[species_name] = class_to_idx[species_name]
    else:
        print(f"Warning: Species {species_name} not found in class_to_idx")

# Create submission with correct column order
submission_data = {"id": submission_ids}
for species_name in species_order:
    if species_name in species_to_class_idx:
        class_idx = species_to_class_idx[species_name]
        submission_data[species_name] = full_pred_proba[:, class_idx]
    else:
        # Default to 0 if species not found (should not happen with correct mapping)
        submission_data[species_name] = np.zeros(len(submission_ids))

# Create final submission DataFrame
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(submission_data)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
